ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider help-desk social-engineered MFA reset followed by attacker-controlled device enrollment
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Scattered Spider / Octo Tempest intrusion opener: a vishing call to the IT help desk drives a password reset and/or MFA re-registration for a privileged target, immediately followed by the actor enrolling their own authenticator from a new IP/UA and signing in. CISA #StopRansomware AA23-320A and Microsoft's Octo Tempest write-up both call out help-desk-driven credential resets + same-day MFA registration as the actor's hallmark initial-access chain.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstReset max(_time) as lastReset values(Change.src) as resetSrcIP values(Change.user) as resetActor from datamodel=Change where (Change.action="modified" OR Change.action="created") (Change.object_category="user" OR Change.object_category="credential") (Change.change_type="AAD" OR Change.change_type="identity") (Change.command IN ("Reset password*","Reset user password","Update user","Register security info","User registered security info")) by Change.user_name Change.object _time span=1h
| rename Change.* as *
| eval helpDeskReset=if(match(command,"(?i)reset\s+password|user registered security info|register security info"),1,0)
| where helpDeskReset=1
| join type=inner user_name [
    | tstats `summariesonly` count values(Authentication.src) as authSrcIP values(Authentication.user_agent) as authUA min(_time) as firstAuth from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="success" Authentication.app="AzureActiveDirectory" by Authentication.user_name _time span=1h
    | rename Authentication.* as *
  ]
| where firstAuth >= firstReset AND firstAuth <= (lastReset+3600)
| eval newDeviceIP=if(mvcount(mvfilter(match(authSrcIP,".+"))) > 0 AND NOT mvfind(resetSrcIP,authSrcIP)>=0, 1, 0)
| where newDeviceIP=1
| table _time user_name object resetActor resetSrcIP authSrcIP authUA
| sort - _time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 3600;
let ResetEvents = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application in ("Office 365","Microsoft Entra ID","Azure Active Directory")
    | where ActionType has_any ("Reset user password","Reset password","User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Update user","Change user password")
    | extend TargetUpn = tostring(parse_json(tostring(RawEventData)).ObjectId)
    | extend ResetActor = AccountDisplayName, ResetSrcIP = IPAddress
    | project ResetTime=Timestamp, TargetUpn, ResetActor, ResetSrcIP, ResetAction=ActionType;
let TargetSignIns = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | project SignInTime=Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, UserAgent, DeviceTrustType, Application;
ResetEvents
| join kind=inner TargetSignIns on $left.TargetUpn == $right.AccountUpn
| where SignInTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| where IPAddress != ResetSrcIP
| where DeviceTrustType in ("Unmanaged","","Workplace")
| summarize FirstSignIn=min(SignInTime), Apps=make_set(Application,10), UAs=make_set(UserAgent,5), Countries=make_set(Country,5), AttackerIP=any(IPAddress)
        by TargetUpn, ResetTime, ResetActor, ResetSrcIP
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FirstSignIn, ResetTime)
| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSec)
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 3600;
let ResetEvents = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in ("Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Update user")
    | extend TargetUpn = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
    | extend ResetActor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | extend ResetSrcIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | project ResetTime=TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, ResetActor, ResetSrcIP, ResetAction=OperationName;
let TargetSignIns = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
    | extend DeviceTrust = tostring(DeviceDetail.trustType)
    | project SignInTime=TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, UserAgent, DeviceTrust, AppDisplayName;
ResetEvents
| join kind=inner TargetSignIns on $left.TargetUpn == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where SignInTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| where IPAddress != ResetSrcIP
| where DeviceTrust in ("","unmanaged","workplace")
| summarize FirstSignIn=min(SignInTime), Apps=make_set(AppDisplayName,10), UAs=make_set(UserAgent,5), Countries=make_set(Country,5), AttackerIP=any(IPAddress)
        by TargetUpn, ResetTime, ResetActor, ResetSrcIP
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FirstSignIn, ResetTime)
| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSec)
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:azure.activeDirectory AND @evt.name:("Reset user password" OR "Reset password (by admin)" OR "User registered security info" OR "Admin registered security info")) OR (source:okta AND @evt.name:(user.account.reset_password OR user.mfa.factor.reset_all OR user.mfa.factor.activate OR user.account.unlock))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog
| EventType=/(password_reset|mfa_factor_reset|mfa_factor_activate|register_security_info)/i
| groupBy([TargetUserPrincipal], function={ collect([_time, ActorUserPrincipal, RemoteAddressIP4, UserAgent]) | sort(_time, order=asc) })
| join({ #event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog EventType=/sign_in_success/i }, field=TargetUserPrincipal, key=UserPrincipal, include=[_time, RemoteAddressIP4, UserAgent, DeviceTrust])
| eval delaySec=(SignInTime - ResetTime)
| delaySec >= 0 AND delaySec <= 3600
| RemoteAddressIP4 != ResetIP
ucs.rationale: Scattered Spider's documented opener (CISA AA23-320A, Microsoft Octo Tempest, Mandiant UNC3944) is help-desk social engineering of password / MFA resets followed within minutes by sign-in from an attacker-controlled device that was never previously trusted. Pairing a reset/MFA-registration event against the same UPN's first successful interactive auth from a different IP within 60 min is a tight,

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider BYOVD EDR-kill drivers and Ngrok/Chisel/RSocx tunnel staging on Windows hosts
ucs.description: Hunts Scattered Spider / UNC3944 post-compromise tradecraft: dropping vulnerable signed drivers (POORTRY/STONESTOP, RTCore64.sys, GMER, ProcExp) to terminate Defender/Falcon/SentinelOne, and installing legitimate remote-tunnel binaries (Ngrok, Chisel, RSocx, Localtonet, Teleport) for C2 — the actor's documented persistence + C2 combo before they pivot to vCenter/ESXi for ransomware.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstSeen values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","rsocx.exe","localtonet.exe","tunnel.exe","teleport.exe","PsExec64.exe","PsExec.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*ngrok*tcp*22*","*ngrok*authtoken*","*chisel*client*","*chisel*server*","*-R*0.0.0.0*","*rsocx*reverse*","*localtonet*")) by Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.process _time span=1h
| rename Processes.* as *
| append [
    | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstSeen values(Filesystem.file_path) as filePath values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("RTCore64.sys","PROCEXP152.sys","gmer64.sys","gdrv.sys","aswArPot.sys","BadRabbit.sys","truesight.sys","viragt64.sys","daxin.sys","PROCEXP.SYS") OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Drivers\\*POORTRY*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Drivers\\*STONESTOP*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path _time span=1h
    | rename Filesystem.* as *
  ]
| stats min(firstSeen) as firstSeen values(process_name) as procsObserved values(file_name) as driversObserved values(cmdline) as cmdline values(filePath) as filePath dc(process_name) as procCount dc(file_name) as drvCount by dest
| eval scoreCombo=if((procCount>=1 AND drvCount>=1),"BYOVD+TUNNEL",if(drvCount>=1,"BYOVD","TUNNEL"))
| where procCount>=1 OR drvCount>=1
| convert ctime(firstSeen)
| sort - firstSeen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let TunnelBins = dynamic(["ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","rsocx.exe","localtonet.exe","tunnel.exe","teleport.exe","frpc.exe","gost.exe"]);
let VulnDrivers = dynamic(["rtcore64.sys","procexp152.sys","gmer64.sys","gdrv.sys","aswarpot.sys","truesight.sys","viragt64.sys","daxin.sys","procexp.sys","mhyprot2.sys","poortry.sys","stonestop.sys"]);
let TunnelProcs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName in~ (TunnelBins)
        or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ngrok tcp ","ngrok authtoken","chisel client","chisel server","rsocx reverse","localtonet ","frpc -c","gost -L","-R 0.0.0.0:")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256, EvidenceKind="tunnel";
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName in~ (VulnDrivers) or FolderPath has_any ("\\drivers\\poortry","\\drivers\\stonestop")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, FileName, FolderPath, InitiatingProcessFileName=InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256, EvidenceKind="byovd-drop";
let DriverLoads = DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("DriverLoad","KernelDriverLoad")
    | where FileName in~ (VulnDrivers)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256, EvidenceKind="byovd-load";
union TunnelProcs, DriverDrops, DriverLoads
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp),
            EvidenceKinds=make_set(EvidenceKind),
            FilesSeen=make_set(FileName, 20),
            CmdSamples=make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Hashes=make_set(SHA256, 10)
        by DeviceName, AccountName
| extend HasTunnel = iff(EvidenceKinds has "tunnel", 1, 0)
| extend HasByovd  = iff(EvidenceKinds has_any ("byovd-drop","byovd-load"), 1, 0)
| extend Severity = case(HasTunnel==1 and HasByovd==1, "critical",
                         HasByovd==1, "high",
                         "medium")
| where HasTunnel==1 or HasByovd==1
| order by Severity asc, FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let TunnelBins = dynamic(["ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","rsocx.exe","localtonet.exe","tunnel.exe","teleport.exe","frpc.exe","gost.exe"]);
let VulnDrivers = dynamic(["rtcore64.sys","procexp152.sys","gmer64.sys","gdrv.sys","aswarpot.sys","truesight.sys","viragt64.sys","daxin.sys","procexp.sys","mhyprot2.sys","poortry.sys","stonestop.sys"]);
let TunnelProcs = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where BinName in (TunnelBins)
        or CommandLine has_any ("ngrok tcp ","ngrok authtoken","chisel client","chisel server","rsocx reverse","localtonet ","frpc -c","gost -L","-R 0.0.0.0:")
    | project Timestamp=TimeGenerated, DeviceName=Computer, AccountName=SubjectUserName, FileName=BinName, CommandLine, EvidenceKind="tunnel";
let DriverFiles = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | extend FileNameLower = tolower(TargetFileName)
    | where FileNameLower in (VulnDrivers) or TargetFilePath has_any ("\\drivers\\poortry","\\drivers\\stonestop")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp=TimeGenerated, DeviceName=DvcHostname, AccountName=ActorUsername, FileName=FileNameLower, CommandLine=ActingProcessCommandLine, EvidenceKind="byovd-drop";
let DriverServices = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 7045
    | extend SvcImage = tolower(tostring(ServiceFileName))
    | where SvcImage has_any (VulnDrivers) or ServiceType has "kernel"
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp=TimeGenerated, DeviceName=Computer, AccountName=SubjectUserName, FileName=SvcImage, CommandLine=SvcImage, EvidenceKind="byovd-service";
union TunnelProcs, DriverFiles, DriverServices
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp),
            EvidenceKinds=make_set(EvidenceKind),
            FilesSeen=make_set(FileName, 20),
            CmdSamples=make_set(CommandLine, 10)
        by DeviceName, AccountName
| extend HasTunnel = iff(EvidenceKinds has "tunnel", 1, 0)
| extend HasByovd  = iff(EvidenceKinds has_any ("byovd-drop","byovd-service"), 1, 0)
| extend Severity = case(HasTunnel==1 and HasByovd==1, "critical",
                         HasByovd==1, "high",
                         "medium")
| where HasTunnel==1 or HasByovd==1
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon AND @EventID:1 AND @Image:(*\\ngrok.exe OR *\\Ngrok.exe OR *\\NGROK.EXE OR *\\chisel.exe OR *\\Chisel.exe OR *\\rsocx.exe OR *\\localtonet.exe OR *\\Localtonet.exe OR *\\frpc.exe OR *\\gost.exe)) OR (source:windows.sysmon AND @EventID:11 AND @TargetFilename:(*\\rtcore64.sys OR *\\RTCore64.sys OR *\\procexp152.sys OR *\\PROCEXP152.SYS OR *\\gmer64.sys OR *\\poortry.sys OR *\\POORTRY.SYS OR *\\stonestop.sys OR *\\truesight.sys OR *\\mhyprot2.sys)) OR (source:windows.sysmon AND @EventID:1 AND @CommandLine:(*"ngrok tcp"* OR *"ngrok authtoken"* OR *"chisel client"* OR *"chisel server"* OR *"-R 0.0.0.0:"*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (ImageFileName=/\\(ngrok|chisel|rsocx|localtonet|frpc|gost|teleport)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/ngrok\s+(tcp|authtoken)|chisel\s+(client|server)|rsocx\s+reverse|-R\s+0\.0\.0\.0:/i)) OR (#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\\(rtcore64|procexp152|gmer64|gdrv|aswarpot|truesight|viragt64|mhyprot2|poortry|stonestop)\.sys$/i)
| ImageFileName!=/\\(svchost|services|trustedinstaller)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ collect([_time, event_simpleName, ImageFileName, TargetFileName, CommandLine]) | sort(_time, order=asc) })
ucs.rationale: CrowdStrike, Microsoft (Octo Tempest), and Mandiant (UNC3944) all attribute Scattered Spider with the same hands-on-keyboard toolkit: STONESTOP/POORTRY signed kernel drivers (and bring-your-own vulnerable drivers like RTCore64.sys, ProcExp152.sys, GMER, Truesight) for EDR termination, paired with Ngrok, Chisel, RSocx and Localtonet tunnels for interactive access prior to BlackCat/RansomHub/DragonF
